The '''Krayt Dragon Graveyard''' was a region of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was the site of several [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] skeletons during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Lightspring]] and an [[Dune Sea mining complex|mining complex]] were located underneath the graveyard.
